Class Pong

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.awt.Component

  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.awt.image.ImageObserver, java.awt.MenuContainer, java.io.Serializable, javax.accessibility.Accessible, javax.swing.RootPaneContainer, javax.swing.WindowConstants

    public class Pong
extends Game
    The main driver class, everything is contained within this class, it extends the game class. Contains a ball, two paddles, and GUI element. Handles general logic like bounds of ball and paddle, winning condition etc.

      • score

        private void score(int player)
        Gives a point to a player and gets the game ready for the next serve. The ball is set to serve toward the player who just lost the point, the score board is updated, and the ball and paddles are moved back to the center. If the player has now reaches winning score, the winner message is shown, and the game is stopped. Otherwise the game pauses before the game continues.
        Parameters:
        player - the player who scored, represented as an integer
